sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have repeatedly recalled holding prices steady for us; it sounds like you want that partnership reciprocated, not simply acknowledged. We value that support and want to recognise your verified cost pressures while making the adjustment predictable for both sides. How could faster payment help us agree a cost-based price adjustment and a workable transition?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%. Our should-cost estimate for Volute casing HN 50-200 is EUR 132.64 per 1 (cost:310010). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 86% of your invoices late, on average 3 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 3 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 127.31 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €134.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
As to the index change and should cost data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
We have carefully reviewed your index data and should-cost estimate, as solid figures always merit our respect in this foundry.
Your commitment to 14-day payment terms and a binding volume allows us to adjust our position in the spirit of our long-standing partnership.
Consequently, we propose €134.50 per unit with the 14-day payment terms and a 1 January 2027 start date.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to stay in touch with our valued partners at Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Over the years, our foundry has taken great pride in maintaining the highest standards of craft and quality for our region, grounded in fair and reliable partnerships.

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. I have read your request for further concessions, but I see no new figures in your message to support this. We have already moved to €129.60 to reflect the 14-day payment terms and the notice period. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

Without new data, this price remains our firm position for a 1 January 2027 start. For your planning, our offer consists of a price of €129.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

I have read your message carefully, but I see no new figures or concrete changes in your term sheet to support further movement. Over the years, our partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH has meant a great deal to our family foundry, and we take pride in the casting quality we deliver to your team. 

We have already made significant concessions to reach €129.60 based on the 14-day payment terms and the notice period. Therefore, our current Angebot stands at a price of €129.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

If you wish to propose different terms, please provide a specific offer; otherwise, our price remains firm. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
